name: Monday Jamaica Pond Social Loop
description: The Monday recovery standard from Forest Hills to Jamaica Pond and back, keeping the miles relaxed and conversational.

name: Tuesday Five Mile Loop
description: A steady Tuesday loop from Downes Field through Jamaica Pond and the surrounding neighborhood streets.

name: Jamaica Pond Short Loop
description: A compact pond loop from Downes Field for warmups, cooldowns, or easy extra miles.

name: Bussey Hill Repeats
description: A hill-focused route from Downes Field into the Arboretum, built around the Bussey Hill climb.

name: Saturday Franklin Park Four
description: A shorter Saturday option that heads from Forest Hills into Franklin Park before returning for the post-run meetup.

name: Saturday Franklin Park Five
description: A Franklin Park Saturday loop with a little more distance while staying close to the Forest Hills start and finish.

name: Saturday Arboretum Hills
description: A Saturday Arboretum route with rolling climbs and carriage-road miles close to Forest Hills.

name: Saturday Double Reservoir Loop
description: A longer Saturday loop linking Jamaica Pond, the Arboretum, and the reservoir paths before returning to Forest Hills.

name: Public Garden and Emerald Necklace Long Run
description: A big long-run route that carries the Emerald Necklace all the way toward the Public Garden before looping back.
